mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 7.0% (from a prior higher level), it signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls below 7.0% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month moving average
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS above 3mo MA) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced corporate output and profit expectations, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: INDPRO declining for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO has declined for two consecutive months (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger a premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.5% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 monthly additions signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 900,000 units, it indicates strong residential construction activity that boosts related sectors and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 900.0 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing and mining output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
